  - Examples containing PII (you can redact or mark with <REDACTED>)

Quality/regression concerns:

- If you have specific "must-pass" examples, mark them in the spreadsheet so we can prioritize.

Next steps:

3) Schedule a short follow-up demo to review results and discuss rollout.
